composition_variation: Show Monkey D. Luffy seated casually on a harbor bollard, holding his straw hat against his chest and smiling toward the horizon. His red vest and blue shorts are fully intact. Use soft cel shading, a peach and apricot sunset, teal water reflections, and a tiny sailboat far below. Frame the seated figure from knees upward in the lower center. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
